overview: A bill payment and data reselling app where users top up a wallet, buy mobile data bundles, pay utility bills, and track every transaction, with an admin console for managing bundles and billers.
features: Sign in and get a personal wallet with a balance
Top up wallet and view a full credit/debit ledger
Browse and buy mobile data bundles by network provider
Pay electricity, airtime, cable TV, and internet bills
Unified transaction history with filters, search, and receipt detail views
Admin console to manage bundles, billers, and view all orders
